sentences.text: 1 original accused both are in the same city at Rajkot and the presence of the accused in the same city would be a threat to the present applicant.

He submitted that the grounds on which the bail has been granted were not sound while the contents of the FIR are not taken into consideration and further the accused is in possession of the photographs of the victim which he has threatened to make it viral.
He has further submitted that the accused has, for almost four times, committed act of rape and extorted the money to the tune of Rs.67,44,500/-.

3. The learned Additional Sessions Judge, Rajkot while granting bail to the accused on 03.04.2024 in Criminal Miscellaneous Application No.955 of 2024 has observed that the victim - the present applicant is aged about 30 years of age, she is mature and has clear sense of understanding and has further noted that the FIR is lodged after delay of one year which has not been properly explained.
NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/7019/2024 ORDER DATED: 12/06/2024 undefined 4.

As per the applicant she is having dealership of "SoliceYanmark Tracto" and is the proprietor of the said dealership while the accused is Saurashtra Revisional Manager of the company and the victim i.e. the present applicant was often meeting the respondent no.2 herein.
The act of rape is alleged to have been committed at the hotel named in the FIR.

The learned Sessions Judge has rightly observed that the victim i.e. the present applicant, who is mature woman aged about 30 years having proprietorship of "SoliceYanmark Tracto" would be meeting the accused - the respondent no.2 herein with the business relationship, had never alleged act of rape earlier and further in view of the observations, learned Sessions Judge granted bail to the present accused.
Thus, there appears to be no reason to entertain the present application for cancellation of bail granted to the accused and, therefore, the present application stands rejected.

( GITA GOPI,J) MISHRA AMIT V.
